findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_glp1_reviews" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_glp1_providers, get_glp1_provider, create_glp1_referral_link, get_glp1_pharmacy, get_glp1_reviews, compare_glp1_providers, search_glp1_reviews · Private data: get_glp1_pharmacy · Public sink: get_glp1_provider, get_glp1_reviews, compare_glp1_providers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_glp1_providers, get_glp1_provider, create_glp1_referral_link, get_glp1_pharmacy, get_glp1_reviews, compare_glp1_providers, search_glp1_reviews · Private data: get_glp1_pharmacy · Public sink: get_glp1_provider, get_glp1_reviews, compare_glp1_providers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
